bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
src_sha=5598a3e366f625c5b860c668b7f13807a7507b7e
ci_package=44838258186
ci_profile=44838258238
old_tag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-mp4-document-4d24
new_tag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:profile-five-5598
rollback=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-profile-five-20261121
local_tag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 60
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 61
test "$(gh run view "$ci_package" -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --json headSha,conclusion --jq '.headSha+" "+.conclusion')" = "$src_sha success" || exit 62
test "$(gh run view "$ci_profile" -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --json headSha,conclusion --jq '.headSha+" "+.conclusion')" = "$src_sha success" || exit 63
oldid="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$old_tag")" || exit 64
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 65
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$oldid" || exit 66
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$local_tag")" = "$oldid" || exit 67
test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d ' ' -f1)" = a65f159d6978867d6e90f76ea71f1341234b300b037647e0751f2af2e72e31c3 || exit 68
docker logs --tail 240 deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -Fq 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY' || exit 69
test -z "$(docker images -q "$new_tag")" || exit 70
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/gace-profile-five-build.XXXXXXXX)"
swapped=0
ok=0
cleanup(){
 rc=$?
 trap - EXIT
 if test "$swapped" = 1 && test "$ok" != 1; then
  docker tag "$rollback" "$local_tag" || true
  docker compose -p deploy -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 fi
 rm -rf "$tmp"
 exit "$rc"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
gh run download "$ci_package" -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot -n gaybbs-profile-bundle -D "$tmp" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 71
test -s "$tmp/gaybbs.mjs" && test -s "$tmp/backfillExistingProfileKeyboards.mjs" || exit 72
docker run --rm --network none -v "$tmp:/bundle:ro" --entrypoint node "$old_tag" --check /bundle/gaybbs.mjs >/dev/null || exit 73
docker run --rm --network none -v "$tmp:/bundle:ro" --entrypoint node "$old_tag" --check /bundle/backfillExistingProfileKeyboards.mjs >/dev/null || exit 74
cat >"$tmp/Dockerfile" <<'DOCKER'
FROM gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
COPY --chown=1000:1000 gaybbs.mjs /app/gaybbs.mjs
COPY --chown=1000:1000 backfillExistingProfileKeyboards.mjs /app/backfillExistingProfileKeyboards.mjs
DOCKER
docker build --network none --pull=false -t "$new_tag" -f "$tmp/Dockerfile" "$tmp" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 75
newid="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$new_tag")"
test "$newid" != "$oldid" || exit 76
if docker image inspect "$rollback" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$rollback")" = "$oldid" || exit 77
else
 docker tag "$oldid" "$rollback"
fi
docker tag "$new_tag" "$local_tag"
swapped=1
docker compose -p deploy -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null || exit 78
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 79
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$newid" || exit 80
ready=0
for i in $(seq 1 18);do
 if docker logs --tail 240 deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -Fq 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY';then ready=1;break;fi
 sleep 5
done
test "$ready" = 1 || exit 81
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 82
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 83
test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d ' ' -f1)" = "$(sha256sum "$tmp/gaybbs.mjs" | cut -d ' ' -f1)" || exit 84
test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/backfillExistingProfileKeyboards.mjs | cut -d ' ' -f1)" = "$(sha256sum "$tmp/backfillExistingProfileKeyboards.mjs" | cut -d ' ' -f1)" || exit 85
ok=1
echo PROFILE_FIVE_BOT_IMAGE=APPLIED
echo PROFILE_BOT_READY=PASS
echo PROFILE_MIGRATION_BINARY=PREPARED_NOT_EXECUTED
echo TELEGRAM_EXISTING_POSTS=UNTOUCHED
echo ROLLBACK_IMAGE_RETAINED=PASS
echo USERBOT_EXISTING_SESSION=PASS
